purpose: Teach: キロメートル/秒間/車掌/電柱/ノース/サウス/サッシ/リール

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場までキロメートル単位で進路を確認されますね
lines.en: The police verify the route in kilometer-long intervals from here to the scene.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, methodical. Voice steady and even. Speaking as though walking through a checklist. No emphasis, just noting fact after fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯カメラの秒間記録を分析されますね
lines.en: The police analyze the security camera footage frame by frame.
lines.style: Same measured tone. Slight pause before 'frame by frame' — giving weight to the detail. Still cooperative in delivery, almost admiring the thoroughness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、駅構内で車掌と連携されますね
lines.en: The police coordinate with the station conductor on-site.
lines.style: Continuing the same steady rhythm. Light emphasis on 'coordinate' — noting the interconnection. Calm, almost quiet satisfaction in how systems work together.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、倒れた電柱の現場の安全確保もされますね
lines.en: The police also secure the area around the fallen utility pole.
lines.style: Same measured pace. Slight lift on 'also' — acknowledging another layer of the operation. Practical, unhurried. No drama, just competence being noted.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ノース署、つまり北署と合同捜査されますね
lines.en: The police conduct a joint investigation with the North Precinct.
lines.style: Continuing evenly. Small clarifying pause before 'North' — explaining without making it seem like explanation. Still in the same cooperative, fact-stating register.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、サウス署、つまり南署とも情報共有されますね
lines.en: The police share information with the South Precinct as well.
lines.style: Same steady tone, maybe fractionally warmer on 'as well' — a small nod to cooperation across the larger system. Still measured. No rushing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、建物のサッシの破損現場も検証されますね
lines.en: The police also examine the broken window frames on the building.
lines.style: Same methodical delivery. Light emphasis on 'also' — another detail, another point on the checklist. Quiet, competent. Voice remains level throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場記録のリール、つまりロールフィルムも保存されますね
lines.en: The police preserve the scene documentation — the film rolls from the original recordings.
lines.style: Slight shift now: a touch more deliberate, with careful emphasis on 'preserve.' The voice carries a note of closure — this is important, the evidence must last. Still calm, but with subtle finality.
